artifact.description: A Return visit's outcome becomes the starting condition for the next cycle in an open-ended relationship chain, distinct from a single instance.
artifact.episode: The Way Home (BH-E003; LONGITUDINAL_PERSISTENCE.md's chain-state transform, CHAINED-CONSEQUENCE-CONTINUITY.md)
artifact.notes: This is the first fixture to actually instantiate the LONGITUDINAL register (previously specified in schema, but never exercised by any LS-COMPILER-01 fixture). relationshipChainId references RelationshipHistory conceptually — the chain itself remains a derived/query view (EV-006); only this transform record is stored, appended to the chain's history.
